name: patent-disclosure-skill
description: 中国专利.skill：专利点挖掘与交底书（发明/实用/外观）编写，通俗解读专利，嗅探政策动向，辅助审查答复。
one_liner: An AI skill that helps engineers turn their work into a proper patent application document, and explains existing patents in plain language.
buyer: A corporate R&D engineer in China who invented something but has no idea how to write the formal disclosure their company's IP department needs.
business_use_cases: An IP law firm's paralegal team uses it to draft first-pass invention disclosures ahead of inventor interviews, cutting billable hours.
A corporate R&D department gives it to engineers so more real inventions actually get filed instead of stalling.
An independent patent agent builds a plain-language 'patent explainer' service for non-lawyers using its digest feature.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a per-document invention-disclosure drafting service to individual inventors.
Run a subscription patent-monitoring and policy-tracking service for a specific industry niche.

steal_this: Offer engineers at local startups a 'get your invention patent-ready in a weekend' service, using this to produce the first-draft disclosure.
